entry.title: Protect source caches from truncated fetches
entry.summary: The scraper detects a sudden large drop in a source's parsed entries before overwriting its last good cache. It reports the old and new counts, falls back to the cache and still checks its streams; a later healthy fetch updates the cache normally. Operators can accept a verified intentional shrink per source, and can adjust the manual-run thresholds. The guard applies to checked and `--no-check` runs; sources without an independent, sufficiently large cache have no baseline.
